text: {"assertions":["On 2026-04-25, a request timeout issue was discovered in services/auth/session_store.py after a rolling fleet restart.","The timeout issue manifested as a 30 second deadline appearing in the gateway log.","The root cause was identified as a race condition in lazy initialization within the session store.","The fix used a double-checked lock pattern to guard the initialization logic.","The fix was implemented in PR #5195 on the branch fix/request-timeout-1.","The issue could be reproduced by sending two POST /login requests against a warm cache.","After the fix was applied, the error rate decreased from 9.6 percent to under 0.03 percent (3 per ten thousand)."]}
